Name: Smartphone - AirDrop
Author: HaPyke
Description:
[center][font=Comic Sans MS]
[size=6][color=#FF6666]A[/color][color=#FFE966]i[/color][color=#92FF66]r[/color][color=#66FFBD]D[/color][color=#66BDFF]r[/color][color=#9266FF]o[/color][color=#FF66E9]p[/color][/size][/font][/center]
[center][color=#ffffff][font=Comic Sans MS]A quick way to send and retrieve items.[/font][/color][/center]
[center][/center]
[left][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]Introduction:[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS]This mod adds a fully functional [b]AirDrop [/b]app into Smartphone, allowing you to send items from your inventory or retrieve item from any chests[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Send:[/b] Select item from your inventory and send it home or to a friend.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#f1c232][size=4][font=Comic Sans MS][b]Retrieve:[/b] Select item from any chests and get it airdrop to you.[/font][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left][center]
[img width=341]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/51143/51143-1787451641-1580388992.png[/img][/center]

[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#00ff00][size=5]How thing works:[/size][/color][/font][/left]
[left][list]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]When in Send items screen, select items from your inventory and send them to farm's mailbox or to an online friend.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]When in Retrieve items screen, you can select the location and the chest you want to get item from, and click retrieve.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]The delivery bird will transport the items for you. You can chase behind it if you want![/color][/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f1c232]The bird will drop a giftbox containing the items.[/color][/font][/size][/*]
[/list][/left]
[left]
